split_policy: Support definitions/intent families only in development; delivery definitions/intent families only in holdout. Synonyms of one definition stay together. Shared SQL primitives are not independent business intents.

documents.title: 可计费支持时长
documents.content: 可计费支持时长：SUM(handle_minutes)，仅status='closed'且billing='billable'，NULL分钟忽略；不是全部已闭单处理时长。

documents.title: 结案工单数
documents.content: 结案工单数：COUNT(*)，仅status='closed'；包含内部工单，不是首次联系解决率。

documents.title: 首响等待均值
documents.content: 首响等待均值：AVG(wait_minutes)，所有状态均包含，NULL忽略；这是首次响应等待分钟，不是修复耗时。

documents.title: 已闭单处理均值
documents.content: 已闭单处理均值：AVG(handle_minutes)，仅status='closed'且非NULL；不是首响等待均值。

documents.title: 支持服务净额
documents.content: 支持服务净额：SUM(fee)-SUM(labor_cost)，仅status='closed'，两个SUM独立忽略NULL，不是税额或续约收入。

documents.title: 按时送达票数

documents.title: 延期票数

documents.title: 准时运输均值
documents.content: 准时运输均值：AVG(transit_minutes)，仅status='delivered'，NULL忽略；不是道路拥堵指数。

documents.title: 计费重量
documents.content: 计费重量：SUM(weight_kg)，排除status='cancelled'，NULL忽略；不是体积重量或仓储重量。

documents.title: 完成派送净额
documents.content: 完成派送净额：SUM(fee)-SUM(delivery_cost)，仅status='delivered'，两个SUM独立忽略NULL；不是盘点成本或保价费。

lifecycle_protocol: Create a synthetic metric on an isolated owned dataset; require ready and one persisted chunk.
Duplicate same source_type/content returns same document and no additional embedding/chunk.
Update the definition; require incremented version, ready and replacement content/chunk, no stale text.
Delete; require missing document and zero chunks, then no_documents retrieval.
A second owner must receive404 for document/dataset reads and cannot retrieve its body/title/ID.

selection_protocol.objective: Maximize (positive Recall@4 + no-match recall)/2 on development; then MRR; ties prefer none then vector, then existing0.70. Zero cross-permission leakage required.
selection_protocol.holdout: One frozen batch only; baseline and selected candidates predeclared, no further selection.
